subject: english
stem: Here is today's first notice. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: the student group at the library chose full covers for the plants
the student group at the library moved every plant indoors
the student group at the library chose no wind protection
the student group at the library chose a low wall for the plants

optionRationales.reason: the student group at the library chose full covers for the plants：此項把「a low wall」改成「full covers」。音稿明確陳述「the student group at the library chose a low wall for the plants」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the student group at the library chose a low wall for the plants」。

the student group at the library moved every plant indoors：此項把「chose a low wall for the plants」改成「moved every plant indoors」。音稿明確陳述「the student group at the library chose a low wall for the plants」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the student group at the library chose a low wall for the plants」。

the student group at the library chose no wind protection：此項把「a low wall for the plants」改成「no wind protection」。音稿明確陳述「the student group at the library chose a low wall for the plants」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the student group at the library chose a low wall for the plants」。
the student group at the library chose a low wall for the plants：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「the student group at the library chose a low wall for the plants」。
